limits: Geometric opposing-digit proximity plus kinematic attachment, not friction or force closure.
Synthetic XR poses and synthetic articulation drives; no F5 proximity bypass in the feasibility trials.
Sand is a collider with local robot ignore pairs, not a granular soil solver.
Grasp depth is measured from the lowest visible hand mesh point to the sand top, not soil compaction.
Conservative hand and arm guards retain original collision/haptic behavior; real haptic perception still requires wearing PICO.
Calibrated yaw axis and excursion limits apply to this simulation model; not calibrated physical robot limits.
Existing radar mask 8/10 excludes layer 11 sand; wrist scan sees the solid support beneath it, not the sand top.
historicalRoundPassMeaning: Initial round passed flags refer to control/collision checks; actual grasp/lift failures remain in each attempts array. Only finalBenchRound.graspFeasibilityPassed represents final all-target feasibility.
